description: Lists fishing waters (revíry) within a radius of a Slovak district town or of given coordinates, nearest first, with distance, water type, river, district and SRZ organisation. Give either city or both lat and lon.

city.description: Name of a Slovak district town, also in other languages or historical form, e.g. "Nitra", "Žilina", "Košice", "Kaschau", "Kassa", "Кошиці".

lang.description: Language of the answer: texts and page URLs in this language. sk = Slovak (original), cs = Czech, en = English, de = German, pl = Polish, hu = Hungarian, uk = Ukrainian, es = Spanish, fr = French, ro = Romanian, it = Italian. Use the language of the user. If omitted, the language of the input is used when it can be recognised, otherwise Slovak.

water_type.description: Optional water type: carp = carp waters, trout = trout waters, grayling = grayling waters, other = other.

name: waters_near
title: Fishing waters near a place
